post.description:
Exports (#48) take the parameters of the synchronous canonical requests; the load limit
of exports (#49) is checked here, at submission.

ComponentSelection.title: ComponentSelection
ComponentSelection.description: Which soil components of a multi-component map unit (SOTWIS, SOTER polygons) are returned.

ExportContent.title: ExportContent
ExportContent.description:
What an export writes (#48): ``all`` the features and their observations (``layout``),
``features`` the features only (the only content Shapefile accepts).

ExportRequest.title: ExportRequest
ExportRequest.description:
POST /exports: the parameters of the synchronous canonical requests plus ``format`` and
``content``. Exports read the canonical path (``canonical`` defaults to true) and write the
whole selection: ``limit`` and ``offset`` are ignored. ``layout`` (``long`` | ``wide``) shapes
the observations table; omitted = ``wide``.

avg_horizons_per_feature_by_dataset.title: Avg Horizons Per Feature By Dataset

ViewOption.title: ViewOption
ViewOption.description:
Which view of the mirror a canonical data endpoint returns (#68).

``raw``: the agnostic ISRIC mirror as stored (default). ``revised``: the decided rules of
``docs/revised-view-rules.md`` applied in the response only (soil_api.revised).
